CONSUMES_NOT_REDEFINES.binding_consumed: Playwright is THE browser Golden Journey runner for J1, J2 and J3.
explicit_non_redefinition: PILOT_READY is defined by the frozen release authority and is NOT restated, narrowed or widened here.
The release stages and their ordering are defined by the frozen ledger and are NOT restated here.
RC semantics are defined by the frozen authority and are NOT restated here.
The three journeys are DEFINED by GOLDEN_JOURNEY_RUNNER.journeys. This artifact carries their harness, not their definition.

WHAT_THIS_LANE_DID.summary: Stood up the Playwright runner and expressed all 23 frozen steps as executable contracts. Did NOT satisfy M9.
WHAT_THIS_LANE_DID.runner_status_before: NOT PRESENT in the repository. No browser automation dependency of any kind existed.
WHAT_THIS_LANE_DID.m9_status: ABSENT, unchanged. M9 requires all three journeys green against a Preview deployment satisfying S4. S4 is not satisfied at this base, so no tier available to this lane can be cited as M9 evidence.
WHAT_THIS_LANE_DID.j1_status: ABSENT, unchanged. 13 of 13 steps expressed as EXECUTABLE_BLOCKED_CONTRACT.
WHAT_THIS_LANE_DID.j2_status: ABSENT, unchanged. 8 of 8 steps expressed as EXECUTABLE_BLOCKED_CONTRACT.
WHAT_THIS_LANE_DID.j3_status: ABSENT, unchanged. 2 of 2 steps expressed as EXECUTABLE_BLOCKED_CONTRACT.

PINNED_DERIVATION.why_pinned: The step set is DERIVED at runtime by parsing GOLDEN_JOURNEY_RUNNER.journeys[].path, which is a comma-separated English sentence. Derivation alone could drift as the prose changes shape; a hand-copied list alone would go stale. Requiring the derived set to equal this pinned set makes a change to EITHER side a loud failure instead of a silent disagreement.

PINNED_COVERAGE.coverage_honesty: 20 of the 23 steps are blocked by target absence ALONE and carry no substantive assertion about the product. They are recorded, not proven. Only 3 steps are backed by a falsifiable posture probe. Presenting 23 green rows as 23 controls would be exactly the defect this split exists to prevent.

POSTURE_PROBES.measured_at_base: no such route segment and no such lib module exists. evaluateProxyRubric.action.ts is a server action on the proxy leg and is deliberately NOT counted as an evaluation runtime.
POSTURE_PROBES.turns_red_when: an evaluation runtime appears, forcing J1 step 12 to be converted into a positive traversal

POSTURE_PROBES.frozen_blocker: the platform principal is a single flag that is also a tenant role value
POSTURE_PROBES.measured_at_base: the boolean column is_super_admin coexists with a role_check admitting the tenant role value super_admin
POSTURE_PROBES.turns_red_when: the two stop sharing the literal, forcing J2 negative control to prove the distinction with two provisioned principals instead of recording it as unprovable

POSTURE_PROBES.frozen_blocker: the public verification read is fail-closed for an anonymous caller after the runtime cutover
POSTURE_PROBES.measured_at_base: the module reads through the shared @/db/client with no service-role or RLS-bypass escape, so an anonymous caller matches no member-scoped SELECT policy and the page answers 404
POSTURE_PROBES.turns_red_when: an anonymous SELECT policy expresses the locator capability in the database, forcing J3 step 1 to become a positive resolution assertion

KNOWN_GAP_J3_DISCRIMINATION.condition: The J3 positive leg and its negative control are currently INDISTINGUISHABLE at the browser boundary.
KNOWN_GAP_J3_DISCRIMINATION.why: An anonymous caller matches no SELECT policy, so a locator that exists and a locator that does not both render 404.
KNOWN_GAP_J3_DISCRIMINATION.consequence: The obvious negative control, request a bogus locator and assert 404, would pass today, would have passed before the cutover, and would keep passing if the refusal were removed entirely and replaced by a blanket 404. It discriminates nothing.
KNOWN_GAP_J3_DISCRIMINATION.what_is_asserted_instead: That the bogus locator is refused AND the response carries none of the verified page own markers, plus an explicit assertion that the indistinguishability still holds, which turns RED when an anonymous SELECT policy lands.

TARGET_TIERS.why_declared: An absent target must be a recorded value, not a silence. A skipped browser spec yields neither a failure nor a reporter row, so an absent journey would read as a successful one.

tiers.note: the deterministic default. Contract assertions run; no browser launches.
a locally booted application is NOT a Preview deployment satisfying S4 and must never be cited for M9

measured_local_app_viability_at_this_bas.next_start_anonymous_probe: HTTP 500 on every route probed, including /login, /signup, /admin, /admin/logs, /app/dashboard, /verify/<locator> and /verify/<locator>/pdf
measured_local_app_viability_at_this_bas.cause: proxy.ts matches every non-asset route and calls updateSession, which cannot reach a Supabase instance. The failure precedes all page logic, which is why even /login returns 500.
measured_local_app_viability_at_this_bas.conclusion: a 500 from absent infrastructure is NOT a governed refusal. Asserting it would encode a temporary blocker as desired behaviour, so LOCAL_APP is supported but NOT exercised by the deterministic workflow.

NETWORK_BOUNDARY.why_a_second_guard: vitest.setup.network-guard.ts is installed through Vitest setupFiles. Playwright loads no Vitest setup file, so every protection it provides is absent in this runner by construction, not weakened.
NETWORK_BOUNDARY.node_layer: globalThis.fetch wrapped in the runner process. Throws synchronously so an existing .catch() cannot turn a hard stop into a retry against a host that will never answer.
NETWORK_BOUNDARY.browser_layer: context.route('**') aborts any request outside the allowlist. Browser traffic never passes through the Node fetch, so the Node layer alone would be silent about the journey own requests.
NETWORK_BOUNDARY.shape: ALLOWLIST, being the declared target origin plus loopback. A denylist is one new vendor out of date; an allowlist states the property the frozen authority requires.
NETWORK_BOUNDARY.stella: no live model call is reachable from this harness. The provider hostnames are not in the allowlist, and no Golden test invokes the assistant.
NETWORK_BOUNDARY.aborted_not_stubbed: a blocked request is aborted, never fulfilled with a stub. A stub would be a development-only workaround inserted into the journey path, which the frozen authority forbids anywhere in a Golden Journey.

PILOT_FIXTURE.nature: DEFINITIONS ONLY. No database client, no seeding function, no migration, no environment read.
PILOT_FIXTURE.why_inert: This lane write-set excludes db/**. A fixture that provisioned itself would have to reach either a canonical environment, which is forbidden, or an invented local one, which is out of scope and certain to drift from the real schema. Materialisation belongs to the lane that also owns the target.

NO_SILENT_SKIP_GUARD.filename_note: The mission named tests/golden/meta/no-silent-skip.test.ts. The extension differs deliberately. vitest.config.ts sets no include, so the Vitest default **/*.{test,spec}.* glob would collect a .test.ts under tests/golden and fail on the @playwright/test import, breaking the default suite every other lane depends on. The natural fix is a tests/golden/** entry in vitest.shared.ts, which is OUTSIDE this lane authorised write-set, and widening a write-set because a change would be convenient is the scope inference the operating discipline forbids. The collision is therefore avoided from the authorised side.
proves: zero .skip, .fixme, .only, bare skip() and testInfo.skip() across every collected Golden file
the scan covers the guard itself, with no self-exemption
the derived step set equals the pinned set, compared in order
every frozen step has exactly one contract, with no orphans and no duplicates
every journey declares at least one negative control
no tier available at this base may be claimed as M9 evidence
positive_and_mutation_controls: the bypass scanner is pointed at tests/golden/meta/fixtures/bypassed-suite.fixture.txt and must report the EXACT set of 8 pattern ids, not merely a non-zero count, which a silently broken pattern would still satisfy
removing one contract must be reported as an uncovered step
adding a contract for an unknown step must be reported as orphaned
a one-step path and a duplicated step phrase must both be refused by the parser
every posture detector is fed remediated content and must flip to false
an invalid target tier must throw rather than degrade to the weakest tier
NO_SILENT_SKIP_GUARD.why_controls_are_mandatory: This repository has shipped a duplicate-key checker built on a JSON.parse reviver that passed on input containing duplicates, and a grep -c that returned the expected count by matching a commented-out line. Both were green and both were vacuous. A check that has never been observed to fail is not yet a check.
NO_SILENT_SKIP_GUARD.why_patterns_live_elsewhere: The bypass patterns live in tests/golden/skip-patterns.ts so the guard source contains no marker literal and can therefore be scanned by its own scan. Holding them in the guard would force either a self-match on every run or an exemption, and an exempt policing file is exactly where a bypass would be parked.
